text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Questionnaire answer sheets, informational 
magazines... That should be all the 
materials, correct?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes. With this amount... we will need to 
make multiple trips. Leave carrying the 
boxes around here to me――

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's a whole lot of luggage! If 
it's alright, please let me lend a hand!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
A Gourmet Fair... Are these preparations 
for that?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. It is a collaborative campaign 
with the racetrack to showcase and promote 
gourmet food recommended by Umamusume. We 
are serving on the academy's executive 
committee.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
We are about to check the survey results 
and compile the information now. First... 
we need to pick out the popular gourmet 
items.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I see... So all the fans will get to taste 
our favorite gourmet foods too, right!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Sharing feelings of happiness through good 
food... Hehe, what a heartwarming project!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Even just reading the questionnaires 
gathers many heartwarming answers. We must 
summarize them with utmost responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
And then... we must gather information on 
each shop... and consider criteria for 
narrowing down candidate stores...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Wah...! Still-chan, you were here too...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I have been here the entire time. 
I am... on the executive committee as 
well, after all...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, let us first tally the 
results and determine the quota of 
collaborating shops.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Even so, there's quite a variety, isn't 
there? Rice dishes, noodles, grilled food, 
sweets... How should we narrow it down, I 
wonder?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
In cases like this, we should establish 
guidelines first... Yet, what should serve 
as our guideline?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
――Ah, then how about "taste"? Our very own 
taste buds!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
If we visit the shops with the most votes 
one by one and actually taste the food 
ourselves, I thought it'd make picturing 
the fair so much easier!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
――! ...Indeed, as the ones delivering it 
to the fans, we cannot simply say we have 
never tasted it ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As the executive committee, we should 
face every gourmet dish with full 
sincerity... Shall we begin our rounds 
now?

One afternoon. Intending to have a late 
lunch, I stopped by a ramen shop. It was 
popular within the academy and a frequent 
topic among trainers, but――

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... So this is the number one most 
popular item, the Extra-Large Ramen with 
Extra Carrots. Quite a volume.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Rather than a light snack while 
watching races, this is the kind of 
gourmet food one sits down to enjoy 
outside of race hours.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a popular shop, there are 
so many customers. Full of both people and 
Umamusume――

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
――Ah, Trainer-san from the academy! Could 
it be that it's popular among trainers as 
well?

Surprised by the sudden callout... It was 
true that word-of-mouth inside the academy 
had spread among the trainers. When I told 
them so――

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! At this rate, it seems sure to 
be popular with racetrack guests too. 
Maybe this shop's already a lock?
choice_data_list: ...Are you conducting some kind of survey?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We are currently evaluating 
candidates for the Gourmet Fair 
collaboration.
choice_data_list:
You're all on the executive committee? 
That's admirable.

You're all on the executive committee? 
Good for you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, no! I'm not on the committee. 
These three are the committee members.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Buena-san was only supposed to help us 
carry materials... Yet out of the goodness 
of her heart, she has accompanied us this 
far.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
She has already investigated multiple 
shops together with us... and provided 
many useful opinions...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! I was just so touched by the 
Gourmet Fair project. I thought I wanted 
to do something to help, and got carried 
away.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Besides, thinking about how to make sure 
all the fans have fun ended up making me 
really enjoy myself too!
choice_data_list:
...Why don't you just join the committee 
then?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... In truth, your mindset has 
completely become that of an executive 
committee member. If Buena-san is willing, 
we would gladly welcome you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Really?! I'm so happy...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Well then, as an executive 
committee member... I look forward to 
working with you all again!
